saw_lines: Conversion buyers already own a bike they like, so they weigh the kit against a new electric bike before they click.
So a buyer who cannot see the saving in the first screen leaves to compare prices elsewhere.
Your homepage shows $349 for the kit, so put a second number beside it, such as the monthly cost of riding, and lead the page with that comparison.
ads_1: Paid creative on the price gap: kit cost against a new electric bike
